name: MnM Bulacan Speedcubing Open 2024
information:
This will be the first WCA-sanctioned speedcubing competition in Bocaue, Bulacan!

Base registration fee is Php 400, good for 3 events. Additional events registered shall entail Php 50 additional registration fee each.
